title: The Gang of Youths Outside City Hall
description: The Modifiers — a motley gang of modified youths from the Workers District of Mos Espa — hang out on the steps of the mayor's office. They were rebels on the hard streets of Mos Espa, stealing water and rabble- rousing, until Boba Fett put them on the payroll. As chief enforcers of the daimyo in charge of Jabba the Hutt's former territory, they act as his eyes and ears on the street, as well as his muscle. But that doesn't mean they can't have a good time with each other when they're hanging out with their customized grav scoots.
